translations.idiomatic: The emperor entrusted all army provisions, weapons, and records to Cen Wenben. Wenben toiled day and night, personally tallying and allocating supplies. Counting-rods and brush never left his hand. His spirit was drained; his speech and bearing were markedly unlike his usual self.

sentences.zh: 上見而憂之，謂左右曰：「文本與我同行，恐不與我同返。」

translations.literal: The emperor saw this and was worried; he told those beside him: "Wenben marched out with me — I fear he will not return with me."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw this and grew anxious. He told those around him, "Wenben set out with me — I fear he will not return with me."

sentences.zh: 是日，遇暴疾而薨。

translations.literal: That day he suddenly fell gravely ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: That very day he was struck by a sudden illness and died.

sentences.zh: 其夕，上聞嚴鼓聲，曰：「文本殞沒，所不忍聞，命撤之。」

translations.literal: That evening the emperor heard the night-watch drums and said: "Wenben has fallen — I cannot bear to hear this; order them withdrawn."
translations.idiomatic: That evening the emperor heard the night-watch drums and said, "Wenben is gone — I cannot bear to hear them. Have them stopped."

sentences.zh: 時右庶子許敬宗在定州，與高士廉等共知機要，文本薨，上召敬宗，以本官檢校中書侍郎。

translations.literal: At the time Right Vice-Gentleman Xu Jingzong was at Dingzhou, sharing confidential affairs with Gao Shilian and others; when Wenben died, the emperor summoned Jingzong and had him, retaining his original rank, concurrently serve as Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Right Vice-Gentleman Xu Jingzong was at Dingzhou, sharing confidential affairs with Gao Shilian and others. When Wenben died, the emperor summoned Jingzong and had him retain his original rank while concurrently serving as Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬子，李世勣、江夏王道宗攻高麗蓋牟城。

translations.literal: On renzi Li Shiji and Prince Jiangxia Daozong attacked Goguryeo's Gaimou city.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Shiji and Prince Jiangxia Daozong attacked Goguryeo's Gaimou city.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，車駕至北平。

translations.literal: On dingsi the imperial carriage reached Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the imperial carriage reached Beiping.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李世勣等拔蓋牟城，獲二萬餘口，糧十餘萬石。

translations.literal: On guihai Li Shiji and others took Gaimou city, capturing over twenty thousand persons and grain exceeding one hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Shiji and the others captured Gaimou city, taking more than twenty thousand people and over one hundred thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 張亮帥舟師自東萊渡海，襲卑沙城，其城四面懸絕，惟西門可上。

translations.literal: Zhang Liang commanded a fleet, crossing the sea from Denglai to raid Beisha city; the city was precipitous on all four sides — only the west gate could be ascended.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Liang commanded a fleet, crossing the sea from Denglai to strike Beisha city. The city was sheer on all four sides; only the west gate could be climbed.

sentences.zh: 程名振引兵夜至，副總管王大度先登，五月，己巳，拔之，獲男女八千口。

translations.literal: Cheng Mingzhen led troops arriving by night; Assistant Commander-in-Chief Wang Dadu mounted first; fifth month, jisi — they took it, capturing eight thousand men and women.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Mingzhen led his troops there by night. Assistant Commander-in-Chief Wang Dadu was first to scale the wall. In the fifth month, on jisi, they took the city and captured eight thousand men and women.

sentences.zh: 分遣總管丘孝忠等曜兵於鴨綠水。

translations.literal: He dispatched separately Commanders Qiu Xiaozhong and others to display troops at the Yalu River.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Commanders Qiu Xiaozhong and others to show force along the Yalu River.

sentences.zh: 李世勣進至遼東城下。

translations.literal: Li Shiji advanced to below Liaodong city.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji advanced to the foot of Liaodong city.

sentences.zh: 庚午，車駕至遼澤，泥淖二百餘里，人馬不可通，將作大匠閻立德布土作橋，軍不留行。

translations.literal: On gengwu the imperial carriage reached Liao Marsh — mud and mire for over two hundred li, men and horses impassable; Chief Artisan of the Directorate Yan Lide spread earth to build bridges; the army did not halt its march.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the imperial carriage reached Liao Marsh. For more than two hundred li the ground was mud and mire, impassable to men and horses. Chief Artisan Yan Lide spread earth to build bridges, and the army did not pause.

sentences.zh: 壬申，渡澤東。

translations.literal: On renshen they crossed east of the marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen they crossed to the east of the marsh.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，高麗步騎四萬救遼東，江夏王道宗將四千騎逆擊之，軍中皆以為眾寡懸絕，不若深溝高壘以俟車駕之至。

translations.literal: On yihai Goguryeo infantry and cavalry forty thousand came to relieve Liaodong; Prince Jiangxia Daozong led four thousand horsemen to intercept; in the army all thought the disparity too great — better to dig deep trenches and raise high ramparts to await the imperial carriage's arrival.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai forty thousand Goguryeo infantry and cavalry came to relieve Liaodong. Prince Jiangxia Daozong led four thousand horsemen to intercept them. In the army all thought the odds hopeless and argued for digging trenches and raising ramparts to await the emperor's arrival.

sentences.zh: 道宗曰：「賊恃眾，有輕我心，遠來疲頓，擊之必敗。

translations.literal: Daozong said: "The enemy relies on numbers and holds us in contempt; coming from afar they are weary — strike them and victory is certain.
translations.idiomatic: Daozong said, "The enemy trusts in numbers and underestimates us. They have come from far away and are exhausted. Strike them and we are sure to win.

sentences.zh: 且吾屬為前軍，當清道以待乘輿，乃更以賊遺君父乎！」

translations.literal: Moreover, we are the vanguard — we ought to clear the road to await the imperial carriage; shall we instead leave the enemy for our sovereign and father!"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, we are the vanguard. We should clear the road for the imperial carriage — shall we leave the enemy for our sovereign and father instead!"

sentences.zh: 李世勣以為然。

translations.literal: Li Shiji agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji agreed.

sentences.zh: 果毅都尉馬文舉曰：「不遇勁敵，何以顯壯士！」

translations.literal: Irregular-Cavalry Commander Ma Wenju said: "If one does not meet a strong foe, how can a bold warrior show himself!"
translations.idiomatic: Irregular-Cavalry Commander Ma Wenju said, "Without meeting a formidable foe, how can a bold warrior prove himself!"

sentences.zh: 策馬趨敵，所向皆靡，眾心稍安。

translations.literal: Spurring his horse toward the enemy, wherever he went all gave way; the troops' hearts were somewhat eased.
translations.idiomatic: He spurred his horse toward the enemy. Wherever he rode, the foe gave way, and the troops' hearts steadied.

sentences.zh: 既合戰，行軍總管張君乂退走，唐兵不利，道宗收散卒，登高而望，見高麗陳亂，與驍騎數十沖之，左右出入；

translations.literal: Once battle was joined, Marching Commander Zhang Junyi fled; Tang troops fared poorly; Daozong gathered scattered soldiers, climbed high to look, saw Goguryeo's formation in disorder, and with several dozen elite horsemen charged in, weaving in and out;
translations.idiomatic: Once battle was joined, Marching Commander Zhang Junyi fled and the Tang troops faltered. Daozong gathered the scattered soldiers, climbed high to look, saw the Goguryeo formation in disorder, and with several dozen elite horsemen charged in, wheeling in and out;

sentences.zh: 李世勣引兵助之，高麗大敗，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: Li Shiji led troops to assist; Goguryeo was greatly defeated; over a thousand heads were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji led troops to assist. Goguryeo was routed and more than a thousand heads were taken.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，車駕渡遼水，撤橋，以堅士卒之心，軍於馬首山，勞賜江夏王道宗，超拜馬文舉中郎將，斬張君乂。

translations.literal: On dingchou the imperial carriage crossed the Liao River, withdrew the bridges to steel the troops' hearts, encamped at Mount Mashou, rewarded Prince Jiangxia Daozong, specially promoted Ma Wenju to Gentleman-of-the-Guard, and executed Zhang Junyi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the imperial carriage crossed the Liao River and had the bridges removed to stiffen the troops' resolve. He encamped at Mount Mashou, rewarded Prince Jiangxia Daozong, specially promoted Ma Wenju to Gentleman-of-the-Guard, and executed Zhang Junyi.

sentences.zh: 上自將數百騎至遼東城下，見土卒負土填塹，上分其尤重者，於馬上持之，從官爭負土致城下。

translations.literal: The emperor personally led several hundred horsemen to below Liaodong city, saw soldiers carrying earth to fill the moat; the emperor took those especially heavy and carried them on horseback; attendant officials vied to carry earth to the foot of the wall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally led several hundred horsemen to Liaodong city and saw soldiers carrying earth to fill the moat. He took the heaviest loads and carried them on horseback, and his attendants competed to carry earth to the foot of the wall.

sentences.zh: 李世勣攻遼東城，晝夜不息，旬有二日，上引精兵會之，圍其城數百重，鼓噪聲震天地。

translations.literal: Li Shiji besieged Liaodong city day and night without cease; after twelve days the emperor led elite troops to join; they encircled the city in hundreds of rings; drum and shout sounds shook heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji besieged Liaodong city day and night without rest. After twelve days the emperor brought elite troops to join him. They ringed the city in layer upon layer, and the din of drums and shouts shook heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 甲申，南風急，上遣銳卒登沖竿之末，爇其西南樓，火延燒城中，因麾將士登城，高麗力戰不能敵，遂克之，所殺萬餘人，得勝兵萬餘人，男女四萬口，以其城為遼州。

translations.literal: On jiashen the south wind blew fiercely; the emperor sent crack troops to the top of scaling poles, burned the southwest tower; fire spread and burned within the city; then he waved the generals and soldiers to mount the wall; Goguryeo fought fiercely but could not resist; they then took it — over ten thousand killed; over ten thousand effectives captured; forty thousand men and women; the city was made Liaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a fierce south wind blew. The emperor sent crack troops to the tops of scaling poles to set fire to the southwest tower. The flames spread through the city, and he then waved his generals and soldiers up the walls. Goguryeo fought hard but could not hold. The city fell. More than ten thousand were killed, more than ten thousand effectives were taken, and forty thousand men and women were captured. The city was made Liaozhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，進軍白巖城。

translations.literal: On yiwei they advanced against Baiyan city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the army advanced on Baiyan city.

sentences.zh: 丙申，右衛大將軍李思摩中弩矢，上親為之吮血；

translations.literal: On bingshen Right Guard General Li Simo was struck by a crossbow bolt; the emperor personally sucked the blood from the wound;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Right Guard General Li Simo was struck by a crossbow bolt, and the emperor personally sucked the blood from the wound;

sentences.zh: 將士聞之，莫不感動。

translations.literal: When troops heard of this, none were unmoved.
translations.idiomatic: When the troops heard of this, all were deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 烏骨城遣兵萬餘為白巖聲援，將軍契苾何力以勁騎八百擊之，何力挺身陷陳，槊中其腰；

translations.literal: Wugu city sent over ten thousand troops to support Baiyan; General Qibi Heli with eight hundred fierce horsemen struck them; Heli plunged personally into the formation; a spear struck his waist;
translations.idiomatic: Wugu city sent more than ten thousand troops to relieve Baiyan. General Qibi Heli attacked with eight hundred fierce horsemen. Heli plunged personally into the enemy ranks and was struck in the waist by a spear;

sentences.zh: 尚輦奉御薛萬備單騎往救之，拔何力於萬眾之中而還。

translations.literal: Palace Carriage Attendant Xue Wanbei rode alone to rescue him, snatching Heli from amidst ten thousand and returning.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Carriage Attendant Xue Wanbei rode alone to rescue him, pulling Heli from amid ten thousand men and bringing him back.

sentences.zh: 何力氣益憤，束瘡而戰，從騎奮擊，遂破高麗兵，追奔數十里，斬首千餘級，會暝而罷。

translations.literal: Heli's anger grew fiercer; he bound his wound and fought; accompanying horsemen struck vigorously; they then defeated Goguryeo troops, pursued the rout for several dozen li, beheaded over a thousand; at dusk they stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Heli, his fury mounting, bound his wound and fought on. His horsemen struck hard, routed the Goguryeo army, pursued the fleeing enemy for several dozen li, and took more than a thousand heads before stopping at dusk.

sentences.zh: 萬備，萬徹之弟也。」」

translations.literal: Wanbei was the younger brother of Wanche.””
translations.idiomatic: Wanbei was the younger brother of Xue Wanche.””
